Subject: Request: staggered auditor access window + activity logs

Hi Marissa / Ben,

We're beginning our Type II review for Acme Payments and need access to your Trust Portal. Two of our reviewers will run in overlapping time zones — Samir (PST) and myself (CEST) — so we'd like to request staggered, time-boxed access rather than a single contiguous window.

Request details:
- Samir Patel: download permission for evidence set A, preferred window 2026-08-03 09:00–13:00 PDT
- Olivia Price: view-only access for evidence set B, preferred window 2026-08-03 18:00–22:00 CEST
- We need an activity log (who downloaded which file + timestamps) for both reviewers for auditability.

Also please confirm whether a bridge letter is required to cover the period between your last report and this review — our compliance lead asked us to collect one if there are any gaps.

If you can provision two separate invites (or one invite with scoped download rights per user) and provide a portal activity extract after the window, that would be ideal. Happy to sign any short acknowledgement if needed.

Thanks,

Olivia Price
Senior Auditor, Crest Audit
olivia.price@crest-audit.com
+1 415-555-0198
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: staggered auditor access window + activity logs

Hi Olivia — thanks for the details. We can support a staggered pattern; proposing a short-run plan below so we can lock in invites and make sure audit logging captures downloads explicitly.

Planned approach:
- Provision two user-scoped invites in the Trust Portal: one for Samir (download scope limited to evidence set A) and one for you (view-only for set B).
- Invite windows: Samir 2026-08-03 09:00–13:00 PDT (provision at 08:30 PDT, auto-deprovision at 13:15 PDT); Olivia 2026-08-03 18:00–22:00 CEST (provision at 17:30 CEST, auto-deprovision 22:15 CEST).
- Portal will export an activity extract (CSV) with username, file id/name, action (view/download), IP, and timestamp — we will deliver this within 24 hours after deprovisioning.
- If download of any restricted artifacts is needed beyond the scoped two-file allowance, we will require a short approval from Acme security and will log the approval in the export.

I've attached a draft bridge letter (bridge_letter_draft.pdf) you can review; it's intentionally narrow and only covers the gap between the last published report and the current audit window. Also attaching an activity report template (activity_report_template.xlsx) to show the fields we will capture.

Can you confirm Samir's download targets (file list or folder names) so we can pre-scope permissions? Also: please confirm whether Crest requires a signed acknowledgement for the access window (we can route DocuSign if needed).

Thanks — looping in Neha from Security to provision and Ben for coordination.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Compliance
Redwood Inference

(415) 555-0123
